The following are [[List of international rankings|international rankings]] of {{flagcountry|Uruguay}}.


[[File:Mate 02.jpg|thumb|180px|right|Steaming [[mate (drink)|yerba mate]] infusion in its customary gourd, the Uruguayan national drink]]

==Demographics  ==
{{main|Demographics of Uruguay}}
*[[List_of_countries_by_population_(United_Nations)|Population]] ranked 134 out 233 nations

==Economy  ==
{{main|Economy of Uruguay}}
*[[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|Nominal GDP]] ranked 80 out of 216 economies
*[[List of countries by GDP (PPP) per capita|GDP per capita]] – 60th highest, at [[International dollar|I$]]11,969
*[[List of countries by income equality|Income Equality]], 0.449 ([[Gini Index]])
*[[List of countries by unemployment rate|Unemployment rate]] – 112th, at 8.70%

== Education ==
{{main|Education in Uruguay}}
*[[List of countries by literacy rate|Literacy Rate]] – 51st, at 97.7%

==Energy  ==
{{main|Energy in Uruguay}}
*[[List of countries by electricity consumption|Total electricity consumption]] ranked 88th highest consumption

==Environment ==
{{main|Environment of Uruguay}}
*[[List of countries by carbon dioxide emissions per capita|Carbon dioxide emissions per capita]] ranked 125th highest emissions

==Geography  ==
{{main|Geography of Uruguay}}
[[File:Uruguay rel 95.jpg|right|thumb|Relief map of Uruguay]]
*[[List of countries and dependencies by area|Area]] ranked 89 out of 195 countries with 175,015 sq km

==Globalization  ==
{{main|Globalization}}

==Government  ==
[[File:Foto Oficial Presidente Luis Lacalle Pou.jpg|thumb|right|125px|Uruguay's president [[Luis Alberto Lacalle Pou]].]]
{{main|Government of Uruguay}}

==Health==
{{main|Health in Uruguay}}
*[[List of countries and territories by fertility rate|Fertility rate]]- 140th most fertile, at 1.85 per woman
*[[List of countries by birth rate|Birth rate]] – 157th most births, at 13.91 per 1000 people
*[[List of countries by infant mortality rate (2005)|Infant mortality]] – 128th most deaths, at 1 per 1000 live births
*[[List of countries by death rate|Death rate]] – 84th highest death rate, at 9.16 per 1000 people
*[[List of countries by life expectancy|Life Expectancy]] – 47th highest, at 76.4 years
*[[List of countries by suicide rate|Suicide Rate]] – 24th highest suicide rate, at 15.1 for males and 6.4 for females per 100,000 people
*[[List of countries by HIV/AIDS adult prevalence rate|HIV/AIDS rate]] – 108th most cases, at 0.30%

==Military  ==
{{main|Military of Uruguay}}
*[[Global Peace Index]] 2009, ranked 25<ref>[http://www.visionofhumanity.org/gpi/results/rankings.php Global Peace Index Rankings] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100521063923/http://www.visionofhumanity.org/gpi/results/rankings.php |date=21 May 2010 }}, Vision of Humanity</ref>
*[[List of countries by military expenditures|Military expenditures as a percentage of GDP]] ranked 104<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20070613005240/https://www.cia.gov/library/publications/the-world-factbook/rankorder/2034rank.html CIA World Factbook]</ref>

{{main|Politics of Uruguay}}

{{main|Society of Uruguay}}
*[[Smoking in Uruguay]]: first country in Latin America to establish an indoor [[smoking ban]]

Unlocking the Promise of Social Entrepreneurship |url=https://www.wipo.int/web-publications/global-innovation-index-2024/assets/67729/2000%20Global%20Innovation%20Index%202024_WEB3lite.pdf |access-date=2024-10-01 |website=www.wipo.int |page=18 |doi=10.34667/tind.50062 |isbn=978-92-805-3681-2 |location=Geneva}}</ref>
